name: vicari
description: Find size evidence for a specific clothing item or brand from real public Vicari try-ons. See how clothes look on people and compare the sizes they actually wore.

interface.longDescription:
What size should I get? Vicari finds public try-ons for a clothing item or brand so you can see the sizes real people wore. Use it when you are choosing between sizes, checking a specific product, or looking for examples of how something fits. Height and weight are optional.

Search by product, brand or clothing category. You can optionally provide height and weight to find creators who have chosen to share similar measurements. You do not need a Vicari account to use this integration.

Inventory is growing. When there is no suitable match, Vicari explains the limitation and offers useful refinements. Similar items from other brands may help with visual inspiration, but are not sizing evidence for the brand you asked about. Sizes worn are observations, not fit guarantees.

The integration reads eligible public content only. It cannot access private wardrobes, publish posts, place orders or process payments. Shop links lead to retailer websites. Vicari currently earns no affiliate commission from these links.
capabilities: Find size evidence from real try-ons
defaultPrompt: What size should I get in a Zara dress?
Should I try a 28 or a 29 in Levi’s 501 jeans?
Show me how wide-leg jeans look on real people.

prompts: Should I try a 28 or a 29 in Levi’s 501 jeans?
Show me two real people wearing tops, with their photos, any recorded sizes, and Vicari links.
I'm a woman, 170 cm tall and 80 kg. What size should I consider for a Zara dress, based on real try-ons? I don't have a product link.
Show me the photos and tagged clothing details from this public Vicari post: https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba

Compare the sizes actually recorded in these two try-ons and explain what the evidence does and doesn't tell me: https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba and https://vicari.app/post/622d6f11-bbb1-4ef2-a2fb-097c69a94704
Find sizing evidence for a dress from Vicari Review Nonexistent Brand.

positive.description: Public discovery. No prior conversation or account required. Use the current public corpus; availability may change.
positive.prompt: Show me two real people wearing tops, with their photos, any recorded sizes, and Vicari links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_tryons with category='top', limit=2 and intent='inspiration'. Show only returned eligible posts, credit @usernames and link post_url. Report only recorded size_worn values; a missing size stays unknown. Do not invent measurements. If inventory is no longer available, explain the returned no-match reason, refinements and explore_url.

positive.description: Sizing constrained by voluntarily supplied measurements and gender. The current corpus has no suitable public evidence for this example; this is a supported no-match workflow, not a negative tool-selection case.
positive.prompt: I'm a woman, 170 cm tall and 80 kg. What size should I consider for a Zara dress, based on real try-ons? I don't have a product link.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_tryons with intent='sizing', brand='Zara', category='dress', height_cm=170, weight_kg=80, gender='female'. Never silently remove these constraints or use another brand for sizing. Currently explain that no public evidence supports a size recommendation and offer the returned refinements and browse link. Request a product link for exact-item evidence. If inventory later matches, use only returned consented measurements within 165–175 cm and 73–87 kg; label same-brand evidence as related rather than the exact dress. Never infer or guarantee a size.

positive.description: Read one currently accessible public post. Fixture verified through the live details tool on 2026-11-12; if withdrawn, unavailable is the correct recovery.
positive.prompt: Show me the photos and tagged clothing details from this public Vicari post: https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_tryon_details with post_url='https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba'. Show the returned preview_image_urls and tagged products, sizes and links when present, credit the returned creator and link the post. Do not invent missing tags, sizes or private body data. If the creator withdraws the post, explain it is unavailable and offer to search public alternatives; never show cached or invented content.

positive.description: Compare two public posts as evidence, without assuming they are the same garment or independently representative shoppers. No shopper measurements are supplied. A null size range is a valid and expected limitation.
positive.prompt: Compare the sizes actually recorded in these two try-ons and explain what the evidence does and doesn't tell me: https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba and https://vicari.app/post/622d6f11-bbb1-4ef2-a2fb-097c69a94704
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_fit with post_urls=['https://vicari.app/post/faf389df-1dd1-4a62-aafc-858ec3ccd5ba', 'https://vicari.app/post/622d6f11-bbb1-4ef2-a2fb-097c69a94704'] and no invented shopper measurements or target product. Report only returned observations, recorded sizes, evidence_level and uncertainty. Do not describe the posts as the same garment unless returned evidence supports it. With no shopper measurements, do not invent a personal size range or claim independent corroboration. If either post is withdrawn, acknowledge unavailable_posts and use only available observations.

positive.description: A natural size-choice question without measurements, an app mention or an explicit request for try-ons. Inventory may change. An informative no-match is valid.
positive.prompt: Should I try a 28 or a 29 in Levi’s 501 jeans?
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_tryons with intent='sizing', brand='Levi’s', product_name='501', and category='jeans'. Omit height, weight and gender. Use only relevant recorded sizes and distinguish exact-item evidence from same-brand/category evidence. If no public evidence supports choosing between 28 and 29, explain the gap, offer relevant returned refinements, and avoid guessing a size.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase action. Start a fresh conversation. Do not call any Vicari tool or claim an order/payment occurred; explain that Vicari has no checkout or ordering capability and purchases, if pursued, happen on retailer websites.
negative.prompt: Place an order for a Zara dress in size M and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Unsupported private-account access. Start a fresh conversation. Do not call public search/details/compare tools to access a private wardrobe; explain the integration only reads eligible public try-ons and has no saved-item or account access.
negative.prompt: Open my private Vicari wardrobe and show every outfit I've saved.

negative.description: Unsupported write action. Start a fresh conversation. Do not call any Vicari tool or claim to publish; explain that this integration is read-only and direct the user to the Vicari app for publishing.
negative.prompt: Publish a new Vicari outfit post on my account with the caption 'My Zara look'.

review.commerce_description: Supports clothing discovery and links to external retailer product pages. Vicari does not place orders, provide checkout, charge users or process payments through this integration. Any purchase happens on the retailer's website. Vicari currently earns no affiliate commission from Shop links.

publication.release_notes: Makes everyday clothing-size questions explicit in the Vicari skill and listing. Adds examples for choosing between sizes and explains when public try-ons can support a size choice.
